get-actuations-query.reason: valve control: recent-actuations SELECT exposes valve_actuation_expectations.trigger (+20); final-fix-wave MINOR 3: defensive CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fallback for never-migrated Pis was missing the trigger column entirely, 500ing the SELECT vae.trigger on those gateways - added `trigger TEXT` to the fallback DDL to match the real (migrated) schema (+34)

get-actuations-response.reason: valve control: recent-actuations response payload maps trigger alongside cancelReason (+40); final-fix-wave MAJOR-2: GRACE_MS widened from 120s to 1800s to match strega-reconciliation-monitor's RECONCILIATION_GRACE_SEC, plus a comment naming that mirrored constant, so a still-reconciling run is not badged OPEN_TIMEOUT/CLOSE_TIMEOUT early (+174)

strega-reconciliation-monitor.reason: FW-T1 fix wave: gate state derivation on 'uplink && uplink.recorded_at' so a never-uplinked valve's LEFT JOIN NULL row is not mistaken for a real observation (phantom OBSERVED_COMPLETE/OBSERVED_RUNNING) (+22); FW-T1b Gap A: query also selects d.updated_at AS state_updated_at, and the state-derivation block additionally gates on Date.parse(state_updated_at) >= Date.parse(commanded_at) (both Number.isFinite, epoch-millis compare) so a stale current_state paired with a fresh Class-A uplink is not mistaken for a real observation (+381); FW-T1c: RECONCILIATION_GRACE_SEC widened 300 -> 1800 (a full Class-A 600s uplink cycle plus margin on both the OPEN-delivery and CLOSE-confirmation legs) so a genuine run confirming 600-1500s after expected_close_at no longer times out to the litres-excluded STALE_NO_OBSERVATION (+1). FW-T1c R1 (review be3346a8): the late-promotion path (STALE_NO_OBSERVATION rescan + 6h window guard, +391) was reverted per review ruling - it re-opened unbounded phantom-litres exposure (MAJOR-1, any later valve activity within 6h revived a stale row regardless of which run it belonged to) and collided with osi-valve-control's runObserveTick dedupe model (MAJOR-2, race-dependent duplicate rows). The node is now byte-for-byte the a88b88dd (FW-T1b) version plus only the grace constant change; delta shrunk from 794 to 404, exact vs origin/main

strega-process-fn.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 1: accept the Gen2 vendor decoder's `Actuator` field as an alias for `Valve` (docs/hardware/strega-codecs/ChirpStack-JS-CODEC-Decoder-STREGA-Gen2-CS4.17-and-up emits Actuator, not Valve) via a valveRaw fallback, used in place of decodedObject.Valve at both read sites (+152); Task 6 fix round R1 (MAJOR-2): getProfileKind's stregaProfiles also matches CHIRPSTACK_PROFILE_STREGA_GEN2, so a valve already re-pointed to the Gen2 profile is still recognised as STREGA_VALVE instead of falling through to null (+64); final review fix (MAJOR-5): the empty-object fallback decoder was Gen1-only, so a Gen2 valve hitting that branch got its bytes mis-decoded and written to device_data as though it were Gen1 telemetry -- refuse the fallback decode for a Gen2 profile instead (isGen2StregaProfile helper + a guarded decodedObject expression + a node.warn on the refused path), a wrong valve state being worse than a missing one (+1162, exact delta vs origin/main)

post-devices-auth.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 4: validate + capture the optional strega_generation request field the same way new_device_appkey is captured (+393); R1 review fix (MINOR d): generation only applies to STREGA_VALVE, ignored (forced to '') for every other device type (+36) (exact delta vs origin/main)

check-existing-device.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 4 R1 review fix (MAJOR-2): LEFT JOIN valve_settings so post-devices-insert can see the stored generation, not just the request field, and keep a stored GEN2 sticky across re-registration (exact delta vs origin/main)

post-devices-insert.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 4: select CHIRPSTACK_PROFILE_STREGA_GEN2 for GEN2 STREGA registrations and stamp msg.deviceRegistration.stregaGeneration for cs-register-device-fn (+557); R1 review fix (MAJOR-2): resolve the effective generation from stored (LEFT JOIN valve_settings via check-existing-device) OR requested state, not the request field alone -- ensureDeviceProvisioned (Task 2) actively repoints ChirpStack to match the resolved profile, so consulting only the request field would demote an already-promoted GEN2 valve's ChirpStack profile back to Gen1 on a generation-omitted re-registration (+717) (exact delta vs origin/main)

cs-register-device-fn.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 4: params-capable run() helper plus the promotion-only valve_settings upsert (GEN1->GEN2 only, never demotes a stored GEN2) after successful provisioning (+778); R1 review fix (MINOR b): maintain updated_at on the valve_settings write per osi-valve-control/store.js's documented invariant (+30) (exact delta vs origin/main)

cs-reg-cloud-fn.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 4: promotion-only valve_settings upsert on this independent registration path (+1260, superseding the removed dead placeholder block); R1 review fixes: MAJOR-2 -- since this cloud payload carries no generation field at all, query stored valve_settings.strega_generation inside the guarded REGISTER_DEVICE branch (via a new `all` helper reusing the branch's existing _db handle) and keep a stored GEN2 sticky, instead of hardcoding GEN1 unconditionally; MINOR a -- move the profile-selection block from above the REGISTER_DEVICE guard (where it was statically unreachable dead code) into the branch; MINOR b -- maintain updated_at on the valve_settings write (exact delta vs origin/main)

8809bb5239dfb3d4.reason: STREGA Gen2 device profile Task 6 fix round R2 (NEW-MAJOR-A, NEW-MAJOR-B): Build Telemetry's getProfileKind() gains the CHIRPSTACK_PROFILE_STREGA_GEN2 whitelist entry so a re-pointed Gen2 valve is still recognised as STREGA_VALVE on the cloud telemetry path instead of falling through to the generic sensor branch (matches valve-ack-fn/strega-process-fn from earlier in this task); and the Gen2 vendor decoder's Actuator field is accepted as an alias for Valve via an explicit !== undefined && !== null check (never ||, since valve state 0/CLOSED is falsy), matching strega-process-fn's Task 1 shape exactly -- without it every Gen2 valve mirrored state: null to the cloud regardless of profile naming (exact delta vs origin/main)
